data.narrative:
Overland AI is a Series A defense & security company founded by Byron Boots, Greg Okopal, and Stephanie Bonk, having raised $40M+. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 10 same-sector and same/adjacent-stage companies—8 private and 2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS)—including comparables such as Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Singularity, and NODA AI.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $40M total raised as a value proxy and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A advancement, implying $80M. Peer-median analysis of the 10-company comp set yields a median valuation of $1.0B, with a range of $125M to $3.0B. The peer cohort includes Series B companies: Dream Security at $3.0B, Harmattan AI at $1.4B, Code Metal at $1.2B, and both Castelion and Defense Unicorns at $1.0B.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $68M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $540M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around stage-of-company maturity relative to the peer set and the early-stage nature of the business. Stage-progression alone produces a conservative floor near $80M, while peer multiples suggest significantly higher value if Overland AI executes to Series B scale and performance benchmarks.
